name: How do I know if I need rooter service or just a drain cleaner?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need rooter service or just a drain cleaner?

acceptedAnswer.text: You likely need rooter service if chemical drain cleaners or basic plungers haven't resolved your issue, or if you're experiencing recurring clogs, multiple slow drains, or sewage backups. Chemical cleaners are often a temporary fix and can even damage pipes over time. Rooter service provides a physical solution by removing the obstruction. If your home in the Las Vegas area has mature trees near sewer lines, rooter service is often the best approach for recurring blockages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose rooter service over drain cleaner for recurring clogs, multiple slow drains, or sewage backups, especially if chemical solutions fail.
